ajout.sous_titre: A plug or a device of the home network, by its address.
ajout.entree: A smart plug by its address: Moli recognizes it, you name it and place it.
ajout.adresse.aide: Moli asks the device who it is, once, without ordering it anything.
ajout.adresse.ou_trouver: In Apple’s Home app (the device’s settings), in the brand’s app or on your router’s page.
ajout.adresse.lecture_seule: Only a read: the device stays as it is.
ajout.cle.titre: This device asks for its key
ajout.cle.aide: It is bound to an account of its brand, and Moli does not hold that key yet. It goes into Moli’s vault and never comes back out.
ajout.cle.ou_trouver: A Meross plug added through Matter or the Home app has none. Bound to a Meross account, the account’s key is the same for all its plugs: once given, Moli uses it for the next ones.
ajout.trouve.aide: Give it a name and a room: it will show there, with the others.
ajout.trouve.deja: It is already in the house ({instance}).
ajout.trouve.protegee: Protected room: agents and unapproved automations act there only with your consent.
ajout.trouve.rien_commande: Adding neither switches it on nor off.
ajout.fait.aide: The device is in its room, with its name.
ajout.fait.aide_sans_nom: The device is added but has not answered yet: give it its name and room from its card once it shows.
ajout.resultat.silent: Nobody answers at this address. Is the device plugged in, and the address right?
ajout.resultat.unknown: A device answers, but Moli does not know it yet. Ask Moli or an agent to add it: they can write its profile.
ajout.code_attendu: Moli is waiting for the house code.
ajout.aide.connus: For now, Meross plugs and power strips (MSS110, MSS210, MSS310, MSS315, MSS425, MSS620). More will come.
ajout.aide.autres: Zigbee devices arrive by themselves through Zigbee2MQTT, Matter ones through their pairing code.
ajout.erreur.invalid_host: An address of the home network, such as 192.168.1.20.
ajout.erreur.invalid_key: This key is not in the right form.
ajout.erreur.invalid_name: Give it a name (60 characters at most).
ajout.erreur.invalid_room: This room name is too long.
ajout.erreur.needs_key: The device asks for its key.
ajout.erreur.not_recognized: The device no longer answers as it did.
ajout.erreur.identity_changed: Another device answers at this address now. Look for it again.
ajout.erreur.duplicate_device: This device is already in the house.
ajout.erreur.busy: Moli is already asking a device. Try again in a moment.
ajout.erreur.limit_reached: Moli already has as many devices added this way as it takes.
ajout.erreur.persistence_failed: Moli could not save it. Nothing was added.
ajout.erreur.probe_failed: The device took too long to answer.
ajout.erreur.unavailable: This version of Moli cannot add devices yet.
ajout.erreur.shutting_down: Moli is restarting. Try again in a moment.
ajout.erreur.connection: Moli cannot be reached right now.
ajout.erreur.auth_busy: Another code is already being asked for.
ajout.erreur.network: Moli did not answer. Check the connection.
